source: Registro Nacional de Costa Rica, public registry extracts
notes: Status is a snapshot on checked_on; registry entries may have changed since.
Green means only that the registry shows no mortgages, claims or notes; it says nothing about how often the lot changed hands.
Price range = five comparable closed sales, declared prices indexed to the 2024-2026 level and normalised to a standard 5000 m2 lot. Land only; buildings are not valued.
Relief (SRTM 30 m) and cover (satellite image, date unknown) are automatic estimates.
owner_is_company: registered owner is a company; a company check is part of the paid report.
